description: Any patient-entered free text (check-in free text, saved question, usefulness comment, sensitive-preferences text). Handled by freetext.ts in the same transaction as the save (FR-17): one Needs-review item on the same-business-day target; when free_text_urgency_scan is on and the emergency lexicon matches, one Urgent item in its place plus help_requested with source lexicon_match. This rule documents the routing for the inventory and harness; the service, not the rule engine, performs it.
author: engineer draft

action.note: Patient wrote a note; read by a person on the same-business-day target
